text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I did it...! We did it, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Cheers resounding so far into the 
distance... It's almost... almost like—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just like a hero returning victorious from 
war, basking in the cheers of her 
hometown...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is how the protagonist of a 
story feels like...!"
choice_data_list: The story is far from over!
The story still has a long way to go!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The voices of all the fans still echo in 
my ears... It's like the lingering 
afterglow of finishing a masterpiece."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best next time too. Just so 
I can experience this feeling again!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's right... the epilogue is still a 
ways off.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To become a true hero, I have to keep 
winning more and more...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll work harder than ever! Trainer, 
please guide me...!
